subject: Proposed evaluation roadmap & acceptance criteria — SummitCorp POC
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@summitcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed evaluation roadmap & acceptance criteria — SummitCorp POC

Hi Asha (and team),

Thanks again for the demo today — appreciate the clear context on SummitCorp's ingestion patterns and the two priority use cases you shared (customer support summarization, sales-readiness embeddings). I promised to follow up with a succinct evaluation plan we can run for the trial, plus ownership and timelines so procurement and security have what they need.

TL;DR: attached is an initial eval plan (redwood-summit-eval-plan-v1.pdf). Below is a 3-week trial proposed roadmap, success criteria, and owners. Please confirm or flag edits and a preferred kickoff date.

Proposed success criteria (must-haves for green):
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 600ms for median prompt set (support summaries)
- Cost: token cost per session within 25% of modeled estimate in the plan
- Quality: F1 >= 0.78 on the 200-item gold prompt set we discussed (labeling provided by SummitCorp team)
- Reliability: zero failed live sessions during a 4-hour peak traffic window (simulated traffic)

Evaluation plan (high level):
1) Week 0 (prep, 2 business days) — kickoff, share seed prompts, grant test dataset access (Summit to provide), network setup details from infra
2) Week 1 (integration) — run sample inference, enable KV caching, baseline throughput/latency tests
3) Week 2 (quality & load) — run labeled evals, run 4-hour peak simulation, collect metrics, iterate prompt/template tweaks
4) Week 3 (wrap) — joint review, collect sign-off on acceptance criteria, handoff next steps for production rollout

Owners (Redwood / Summit recommended):
- Redwood: Jonas (technical lead / trial orchestration), Marissa (infrastructure & scaling, pre-kickoff checklist), Rachel (solutions / quality measurement)
- SummitCorp: Asha (product owner), Tom (infra/procurement)

Timeline (suggested):
- Target kickoff: Nov 9, 2026
- Trial window: Nov 9 — Nov 27, 2026
- Final decision/review: Nov 30, 2026

Attachments included: redwood-summit-eval-plan-v1.pdf (detailed runbook), redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf (SOC2 summary), pre-kickoff-checklist.xlsx

Open items for SummitCorp:
- Confirm gold prompt set delivery date (we suggested Nov 6)
- Confirm procurement timeline / PO window (Marissa, Rachel — want to know if this blocks kickoff)
- Provide point of contact for security questionnaire and egress requirements

Next steps if this looks good:
- I’ll update the plan with any edits and schedule the kickoff.
- Marissa will send the pre-kickoff infra checklist to Tom.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Jonas

Subject: Re: Proposed evaluation roadmap & acceptance criteria — SummitCorp POC

Jonas — thanks for the detailed note and the plan. This is very helpful. A few quick items from our side:

1) Success criteria edits:
- Quality target: can we measure both F1 and a qualitative 1-5 rubric on 50 human-reviewed samples? We find the rubric helps surface edge cases faster.
- Latency: 600ms 95th is fine for the support summarization path; for the embeddings use case we need 99th <= 250ms for small requests — otherwise material UX impact.

2) Procurement/security:
- We need the SOC2 full report (or a redacted copy) for our procurement team. The summary is a good start but they usually request the full report. Can you provide either the full SOC2 or an SOC2 letter?
- Security contact: please loop in sec-ops@summitcorp.com — they’ll run the network egress and encryption checks.
- Procurement timeline: we cannot commit to a PO until the security review completes; target for PO is Nov 22 if reviews go smoothly.

3) Dataset & access:
- We can deliver the gold prompt set on Nov 6 but it will be a redacted subset first (PII-stripped) — full set may take an additional week. Is the redacted subset sufficient for the Week 2 quality run?

If these adjustments are OK with your team, Nov 9 kickoff still works on our side. We’ll confirm by EOD Nov 5 after our internal security triage.

Thanks,
Asha
Director, Product — SummitCorp
asha.patel@summitcorp.com
+1 (617) 222-3344

- SOC2: attaching redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf in this thread; for the full report we can provide a SOC2 letter or arrange an NDA-backed share with your procurement team. Marissa — can you coordinate the SOC2 full-report request and point of contact?
